intro: Deviate Eradication is a task assigned by the night elf druid Ebru above the entrance to the Wailing Caverns. While other disciples focus on waking their slumbering leader, Ebru asks adventurers to purge the caverns of mutated deviate beasts spawned by his twisted vision. Ridding the subterranean oasis of these horrors is an essential step in stemming the corruption threatening the Barrens.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Our great leader aspired to enter the Emerald Dream and help regrow these harsh lands back into the lush forest it once was. But something went terribly wrong.
Naralex's dream turned into a nightmare and corrupt creatures began to inhabit the caverns.
While some Disciples of Naralex seek to awake our master, my concern is with ridding these caves of the evil beasts.
Brave the caverns, friend, and eradicate the deviate spawn.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, we, the Disciples of Naralex, need your help. Our numbers are dwindling with our master trapped in his twisted nightmare. We have not the forces necessary to deal with the corrupt creatures which now haunt these caverns.
I beg of you, enter the caves and wage war on the deviate creatures!

clips.title: Completion
paras: As a Disciple of Naralex, I commend your bravery, friend.
Your aid in ridding the caverns is the first step in our long plight to see the Barrens restored.
Thank you and may you prosper.
